No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahsokatanowithlightsabers_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>.
